info.title: Nyaya API
info.description: Single write path for the Flutter app and the Content Management Portal. Errors use { code, message, details, request_id }. Timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC.

expires_at.description: Answers are refused after this; submitting is still allowed

min_app_version.description: The oldest app version that may still be used. An older build shows an update screen. Null: no build is blocked.

update_url.description: The store page the update screen opens (https). Null: no button.

question_count.description: Questions whose latest version is in this topic

live_count.description: Questions with a live (published) version here

slug.description: Lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens. Fixed once created: the app, progress and import files refer to it.

is_active.description: Shown to learners. Showing a subject adds a chapter to the Case Path road; hiding it removes its questions from quizzes.

slug.description: Lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens. Fixed once created: the app, progress and import files refer to it.

is_active.description: Hiding a topic removes its questions from quizzes at once

slug.description: Lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens. Fixed once created: the app, progress and import files refer to it.

withdrawn.description: Exam import only: rows the exam body withdrew. No question is made; each becomes a withdrawn paper position

with_warnings.description: Created rows that still need something before review

row.description: Row number in the file; the header is row 1

outcome.description: created: a new draft (or would be, in a test run); skipped: already in the bank; failed: has errors; withdrawn: key says WITHDRAWN, so no question is made (exam import)

question_id.description: The new draft, or the existing question it duplicates

id.description: Null for a test run, which is not saved
Null for a test run, which is not saved

row.description: Row number in the imported file

position.description: The position this row would take (file order)

ready.description: True when the question has a published version to pin

question_version_id.description: Null for a withdrawn position, which pins no question

original_ref.description: The row's external_ref, if it had one

ready.description: Rows with a published version to pin

not_ready.description: Rows still waiting on review or publishing

positions.description: Positions for the rows that are ready, in the format of PUT /admin/exam-papers/{id}/positions. Read-only: nothing is saved.

setup.description: Set while a setup link is waiting to be used

setup_token.description: Shown once: put it in the link to the portal setup page and send it to the person

is_active.description: false disables the account and signs it out everywhere

token.description: The token from the setup link

active_learners.description: Opened the app, played a quiz or asked the AI

eligible.description: Sign-ups (last 90 days) old enough to be measured

retained.description: Of those, active exactly that many days after signing up

average_score_percent.description: Average share of questions right in finished quizzes, 0–100

correct_percent.description: Share of answers that were right, 0–100

open_reports.description: Reports not yet closed by staff

min_answers.description: Answers needed before a question is ranked

daily.description: One entry per day, oldest first

latest.description: The newest version, which is the one actions apply to

correct_option_ids.description: Never sent to learners before they answer

content_source_id.description: Where the content comes from (attribution only; it never blocks publishing).

concept_key.description: Questions testing the same concept share a key; a mock uses at most one of them

alternate_correct_option_ids.description: Further options an official key also accepts; never one of correct_option_ids

lock_option_order.description: Show the options in the stored order, never shuffled

exam_only.description: Exam-only questions are never used by the learning games. Can only be changed before the first publish.

exam_ids.description: The exams this question may be used in. An exam-only question needs at least one to be published.

correct_option_ids.description: Never sent to learners before they answer

content_source_id.description: Where the content comes from (attribution only; it never blocks publishing).

concept_key.description: Questions testing the same concept share a key; a mock uses at most one of them

alternate_correct_option_ids.description: Further options an official key also accepts; never one of correct_option_ids

lock_option_order.description: Show the options in the stored order, never shuffled

exam_only.description: Exam-only questions are never used by the learning games. Can only be changed before the first publish.

exam_ids.description: The exams this question may be used in. An exam-only question needs at least one to be published.

question_ids.description: Questions to act on; each is checked and run on its own

status.description: Status of the latest version after the step, when ok

change_note.description: Why the published question is changing

mode.description: case_path: one level (one subject, one difficulty). daily_docket: today's set, the same for everyone, once a day. duel: practice against the clock. exam: answers revealed at the end. mistake_review: your own wrong answers, free. Decides feedback and rewards.

negative_marking.description: Exam only: take 0.25 off for each wrong answer

difficulty.description: Only this difficulty; any when omitted

question_id.description: The question (all versions), for saving it

options.description: In the order to show them

feedback.description: Only after this question is answered (immediate mode) or the session is submitted

name.description: "Asha K.", or a practice player's name

practice.description: A practice player, used when no learner's duel fitted

opponent_answers.description: The opponent's run, in question order: whether each answer was right and how long it took

selected_option_ids.description: Empty means time ran out. Allowed only where each answer is explained at once (not exams); it scores as unanswered and still returns the feedback.

elapsed_ms.description: Milliseconds from showing the question to answering, as the app measured it. Duels race on it.

mode_multiplier.description: 1.25 for the docket, 0.5 for replaying a 3-star level, else 1

energy_bonus.description: Energy given back for a first 3-star clear

best_stars_before.description: Best stars on this level before this session

new_stars.description: Stars added to the level best

streak_extended.description: True when this was today's first finished quiz

deadline_at.description: Set by the server; the app only displays it

server_now.description: The server clock, to correct for device skew

result_available.description: True once finalised: results can now be fetched

current.description: Current streak today; 0 once it has lapsed

active_days.description: Days with a finished quiz, last 21, India dates

frozen_days.description: Missed days a freeze covered, last 21

best.description: Best score as a fraction of the session total, 0–1

rating.description: Hidden rating used to pick opponents

today.description: India date the figures are for

settings.description: Null until the learner saves settings once

last_week.description: Last week, for closing the league

stars.description: Best Case Path stars per level id

me.description: This row is the signed-in learner

practice.description: A simulated player topping up a small group

bonus_coins.description: Coins for finishing in the top 3

joined.description: Joined this week's league (with a quiz)

last_result.description: How the latest finished week ended

me.description: This row is the signed-in learner

total.description: Learners on the board (everyone with XP)

me.description: The learner, also when outside the top 50; null without XP

available.description: False when retired or no longer in force

updated_since.description: The question was revised after the learner answered it; this is the version they answered

messages.description: The conversation so far, oldest first, ending with the learner's question (at most 20 turns)

url.description: The page the answer drew on

sources.description: Pages (India Code, Supreme Court of India, Wikipedia) the answer relied on; absent when none were used

stem.description: Question text of the reported version

urgent.description: Wrong answer and outdated law are legal errors: handle first

outcome.description: fixed: the question was revised; retired: taken out; no_change: the question is right

image_url.description: The card picture's path on this API (WebP); null when the article has none

url.description: Path on this API (staff only); changes when the picture does

changes_reason.description: Why changes were last requested, while they still are

image.description: The card picture, if one was uploaded

changes_reason.description: Why changes were last requested, while they still are

publish_date.description: The India day the tip is shown on Home
The India day the tip is shown on Home

confirmed_against_source.description: Must be true: the editor opened the exact official source link and confirmed the tip matches it

collection_url.description: The collection page on India Code

fetched_at.description: When India Code was last read; null if it never was

stale.description: True when India Code could not be reached and reviewed values are shown

size_bytes.description: As India Code reports it; treat as approximate (the served file can differ)

checksum_md5.description: MD5 as India Code reports it

source_modified_at.description: The day the item last changed on India Code

large.description: A large download: warn before opening on mobile data

scanned.description: Scanned pages with no text layer: cannot be searched or read aloud

title.example: The Constitution of India in Tamil

source_title.description: India Code's own title for the item, kept for attribution (it can contain typos)

authority_note.description: Reviewed wording about this edition’s legal standing; null until approved. Do not infer authority when null.

download_url.description: Official India Code address of the PDF (https, India Code host only)

source_page_url.description: The item's page on India Code

notice.description: Neutral attribution to show with the list

changed_fields.description: What differs from the reviewed values: bitstream, checksum, size, text_layer

modified_since_review.description: The item was edited on India Code after the review, though its file may be the same

last_error.description: Why the last read of India Code failed, if it did

new_items.description: On India Code but not in the manifest: hidden from the app until curated

is_current.description: True for the one blueprint randomised mocks of this exam use. At most one per exam, and only a published one; it is set on purpose, never by publishing.

timed_allowed.description: Whether this blueprint may be used for timed mocks. False unless it is published and official-confirmed.

is_active.description: Turning an exam on needs at least one published blueprint. New exams start off.

blueprint_id.description: The blueprint whose rule was applied, if any

negative_marks.description: Marks taken off a wrong answer, as a positive number

law_regime_filter.description: How randomised mocks treat questions only about the old codes (IPC, CrPC, Evidence Act). Random mocks test current law, so any (the default), exclude_old and prefer_new all leave them out; only include_all lets them in. Fixed historical papers are never filtered.

config_source.description: The official document the rules come from

negative_marks.description: Marks taken off a wrong answer, as a positive number

law_regime_filter.description: How randomised mocks treat questions only about the old codes (IPC, CrPC, Evidence Act). Random mocks test current law, so any (the default), exclude_old and prefer_new all leave them out; only include_all lets them in. Fixed historical papers are never filtered.

config_source.description: The official document the rules come from

duration_seconds.description: Only for a section with its own timer

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the source document, lower-case hex

allowed_uses.description: What the source may be used for, e.g. "practice questions"

practice_timer_seconds.description: Optional practice clock in seconds (60 to 86400), shown to learners as practice timing that BCI has not confirmed. It does not enable the official timed mode. Null removes it.

withdrawn_policy.description: Interim rule for withdrawn questions: unscored leaves them out of the marks

withdrawn_policy_confirmed.description: True only when the rule has been confirmed from the exam body. award_all needs it.

practice_timer_seconds.description: Optional practice clock in seconds (60 to 86400), shown to learners as practice timing that BCI has not confirmed. It does not enable the official timed mode. Null removes it.

question_version_id.description: The exact question version to pin. Omit (or null) for a withdrawn question, which is kept as a placeholder.

original_ref.description: The number in the original paper

option_order.description: Option ids in the order shown; leave out to use the version's own order

official_key_text.description: The key as the exam body printed it

withdrawn_note.description: Why a withdrawn question was withdrawn

accepted_option_ids.description: Every option the body accepted; empty for a withdrawn question

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the document, lowercase hex

seed.description: Reuse a seed to get the same plan again. Without it the server picks one and returns it.

seen_question_ids.description: Question ids the learner has already met; unseen ones are preferred

withdrawn.description: withdrawn positions are placeholders with no question text; they are not questions

paper_id.description: Required for fixed_paper: a published paper of this exam

mode.description: practice has no deadline. timed gets a server deadline and is only allowed when the rules are officially confirmed.

practice_timer.description: fixed_paper in practice mode only: run the paper's practice timer (a server deadline). It is practice timing, not the official timed mode, and needs no confirmed rules.

withdrawn.description: A withdrawn position is a placeholder, not a question

selected_option_ids.description: The chosen option ids; empty clears the answer

seq.description: A counter the client raises with every change to this answer. The server keeps the answer with the highest counter, so a late or repeated request never overwrites a newer one.

results.description: Per answer: applied, or why it was ignored (stale, duplicate, conflict), with what the server holds
